IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_accepted: SOS accepted. Stay within 70 tiles while the crew reboards, then cover {distance} tiles and 30 seconds of driving. Reward: +3 faction favor.
IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_busy: Another survivor is already covering this convoy.
IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_cover: SOS: cover the crew until they reboard. Stay within 70 tiles; leaving for a minute fails the rescue.
IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_escape: SOS: the convoy is ready to escape. Cover {distance} tiles and at least 30 seconds of driving within 70 tiles.
IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_progress: SOS escape: {distance}/{target} tiles, {seconds}/30 seconds of driving. Stay within 70 tiles.
IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_done: Convoy rescued! +{reward} faction favor (up to the faction favor limit).
IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_reason_absent: the rescuer died or left the convoy for a minute
IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_reason_lost: the convoy was lost before its escape was verified
IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_reason_hostile: the convoy became hostile to its rescuer
IGUI_ALC_ui_sos_reason_disabled: rescue contracts were disabled by the host
IGUI_ALC_hail_ok_1: Pulling over. Make it quick, we have a schedule.
IGUI_ALC_hail_ok_2: Alright, we're stopping. What do you want?
IGUI_ALC_hail_busy_2: I heard you the first time.
IGUI_ALC_hail_refuse_1: We don't stop for strangers. Keep off the road.
IGUI_ALC_hail_hostile_1: Get off the road or we open fire!
IGUI_ALC_hail_hostile_2: Wrong convoy to wave at, friend. Back off.
IGUI_ALC_news_1: Roads past {town} are crawling. Keep your engine running.
IGUI_ALC_news_2: Day {day} and we're still driving. That's the news.
IGUI_ALC_news_3: Fuel is getting scarce. {faction} pays for jerrycans now.
IGUI_ALC_news_4: Saw a big horde moving along the highway. Don't stop in the open.
IGUI_ALC_news_5: Radio says Louisville is sealed. Everyone says something different.
IGUI_ALC_news_6: If you see a convoy flashing its lights, it's not a rescue. Stay clear.
IGUI_ALC_news_dest_1: We're bound for {dest}. Two more hours if the road is clear.
IGUI_ALC_news_dest_2: {faction} business in {dest}. Nothing you'd care about.
IGUI_ALC_news_dest_3: Heading to {dest}. Came through {town}, it's quiet for now.
IGUI_ALC_trade_open_1: Have a look. Cash or goods we can use.
IGUI_ALC_trade_open_2: We carry a few extras. Pay in cash or trade, it's yours.
IGUI_ALC_trade_done_2: {item}. Don't spend it all at once.
IGUI_ALC_trade_none_2: This isn't a shop. Move on.
IGUI_ALC_trade_broke_1: That's not enough. Add something or take less.
IGUI_ALC_trade_broke_2: Come back when you have something worth trading.
IGUI_ALC_trade_refuse_2: Keep your junk. Not with you.
IGUI_ALC_ride_ok_1: Hop in. We're going to {dest}, no detours.
IGUI_ALC_ride_ok_2: Free seat in the back. Don't touch anything.
IGUI_ALC_wait_ok_1: Fine, we'll wait a bit. Be quick.
IGUI_ALC_blocked_2: Move that thing out of the way!
IGUI_ALC_threat_fold_1: Easy! Take it and let us go!
IGUI_ALC_threat_fold_2: Don't shoot! Here, take this, we're leaving!
IGUI_ALC_threat_fight_2: You picked the wrong people. Dismount!
IGUI_ALC_threat_laugh_1: Ha! You're threatening us? Boys, teach him.
IGUI_ALC_toll_ask_1: Road tax, {price}. Pay up or turn around.
IGUI_ALC_toll_ask_2: This road is ours. {price} and you pass.
IGUI_ALC_toll_paid_1: Smart. Go on, nobody touches you today.
IGUI_ALC_toll_paid_2: Paid in full. Drive safe, ha.
IGUI_ALC_toll_broke_1: No money? Then you've got nothing we want. Scram.
IGUI_ALC_flee_2: Floor it! Get us out of here!
IGUI_ALC_arrive_1: {dest}. We made it. Short stop, then we move on.
IGUI_ALC_arrive_2: This is {dest}. Unload, stretch your legs, we leave soon.
IGUI_ALC_arrive_riders_1: {dest}, end of the line for passengers. Out you get.
IGUI_ALC_arrive_riders_2: We're in {dest}. Passengers off, or ride on to the next town.
IGUI_ALC_passing_3: Convoy passing. Don't get in the way.
IGUI_ALC_escort_ok_1: An escort to {dest}? Fine. Stay close and keep up; we pay on arrival.
IGUI_ALC_escort_ok_2: Alright, ride with us to {dest}. Don't fall behind.
IGUI_ALC_escort_refuse_1: We don't need you watching our backs.
IGUI_ALC_escort_done_1: {dest}, as agreed. Here's your pay. {faction} remembers.
IGUI_ALC_escort_done_2: We made it. Take this, you earned it.
IGUI_ALC_escort_void_1: Where did our escort go? Forget it, we're on our own.
IGUI_ALC_escort_void_2: You left us. No pay for that.
IGUI_ALC_ambush_zombies_1: Horde on the road! Everybody out, clear them!
IGUI_ALC_ambush_zombies_2: Dead ahead, lots of them. Dismount and clear the road!
IGUI_ALC_ambush_raiders_1: Ambush! Raiders on the road, out and fight!
IGUI_ALC_ambush_clear_1: Road's clear. Back in the cars, let's go.
IGUI_ALC_ambush_clear_2: That's all of them. Mount up.
IGUI_ALC_regroup_1: Slowing down, the tail is lagging. Close up!
IGUI_ALC_regroup_2: Keep the convoy together. Catch up back there!
IGUI_ALC_driver_down_1: Driver's down! Somebody take the wheel!
IGUI_ALC_driver_down_2: We lost the driver. Swap seats, we're not stopping here.
IGUI_ALC_abandon_1: That car's done. Grab what you can and get in with us.
IGUI_ALC_abandon_2: Leave it. We go on with what still runs.
IGUI_ALC_stuck_1: We're stuck. Finding another way around.
IGUI_ALC_stuck_2: Road's blocked. Hold on, looking for a way through.
IGUI_ALC_radio_1: {faction} convoy {name} to all stations: passing {town}, bound for {dest}. Road is open behind us.
IGUI_ALC_radio_2: This is {name}, {faction}. Moving through {town} toward {dest}. Keep your distance from the column.
IGUI_ALC_radio_3: {name} here. {leader} speaking. We reach {dest} tonight if the road holds. Over.
IGUI_ALC_radio_4: All stations, {faction} convoy {name} on the road near {town}. Traders welcome at the stops, nobody else.
IGUI_ALC_scavenged_1: We found some useful supplies. Loading them now.
IGUI_ALC_scavenged_2: This place had something left. Packing it up.
IGUI_ALC_breakdown_1: Engine trouble. Give us a minute.
IGUI_ALC_breakdown_2: Something just broke. We're checking it.
IGUI_ALC_refueled_2: Fuel sorted. Back on the road.
IGUI_ALC_merged_1: We're joining the other convoy. Keep the formation tight.
IGUI_ALC_merged_2: Two columns, one destination. Fall in.
IGUI_ALC_horde_block_1: Zombies at the doors. Stay inside, we are moving!
IGUI_ALC_horde_block_2: Too close! Back to the cars. Find us a way out.
IGUI_ALC_safehouse_visit_1: Short stop at the safehouse. Watch the perimeter.
IGUI_ALC_safehouse_visit_2: We're checking the safehouse. Stay close.
IGUI_ALC_distress_help_1: You answered our call. Thank you.
IGUI_ALC_distress_help_2: Help arrived just in time. We owe you.
IGUI_ALC_recruit_ok_1: Take them with you. Keep them alive.
IGUI_ALC_recruit_ok_2: They're yours now. Good luck out there.
IGUI_ALC_recruit_refuse_2: Our crew is already too small. No.
IGUI_ALC_inspect_ok_1: Take a look at the cargo.
IGUI_ALC_inspect_refuse_1: Cargo stays closed until we stop.
IGUI_ALC_inspect_refuse_2: Not while we're moving. Ask later.
IGUI_ALC_form_ok_1: You've got a crew. Now keep them together.
IGUI_ALC_form_ok_2: Your caravan, your responsibility. Move out.
IGUI_ALC_form_refuse_not_enough_1: You need at least two people for a caravan.
IGUI_ALC_form_refuse_not_enough_2: One recruit isn't a convoy. Find another.
IGUI_ALC_give_supplies_1: Supplies accepted. We won't forget this.
IGUI_ALC_event_supply_drop_1: Supply drop ahead. Secure the area.
IGUI_ALC_event_supply_drop_2: Those crates are ours. Load them quickly.
IGUI_ALC_event_refugees_1: Refugees on the road. Give them some room.
IGUI_ALC_event_refugees_2: They're coming with us. Make space.
IGUI_ALC_event_medical_aid_2: We've got wounded. Keep the road clear.
IGUI_ALC_event_trade_fair_1: Trade fair ahead. Business as usual.
IGUI_ALC_event_trade_fair_2: We're holding a trade stop. Bring your offers.
IGUI_ALC_event_scavenger_haul_1: Good haul today. Don't waste it.
IGUI_ALC_ui_basket_ready: Offer ready. Extra value is a gift; no cash change.
IGUI_ALC_ui_basket_short: Add goods worth {amount} to complete this offer
IGUI_ALC_ui_quantity_hint: Click to add; right-click to remove. Hold Shift for five.
IGUI_ALC_ui_contact_hint: Stop the convoy to trade or board. Stay nearby.
